title: The drafted search plan queried the indexes with the project's own labels and coined names

found.context: Stage D paper-mode run of the demo project against the live indexes

observed_failure: lit_search.py plan took keywords from the story spine, so the drafted queries contained RQ1, RWN and SynthLoad: labels and names that exist only inside this project and match nothing, or the wrong thing, in the literature.
expected_behavior: Labels such as RQ1, H2 or C007 never become keywords, and coined or acronym terms are listed for the author to review before the plan is used.

resolution.summary: keywords skip workflow labels; possible project-internal terms are listed in the plan's _review block

lessons: A search plan drafted from the story inherits the story's private vocabulary; a person must review it.
